Definition: Maon, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Maon or Maonites = "habitation"; n pr m; 1) a man of Judah; 2) the inhabitants of the city of Maon; n pr loc; 3) a city of Judah located 8 miles south of Hebron
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
